# 100CGI Studio

> > 100CGI Studio delivers architectural visualization, 3D rendering, and virtual tour services using 3ds Max, V-Ray, and Corona Renderer for luxury real estate and commercial developments.

Based in London, 100CGI Studio specializes in photorealistic exterior rendering, interior visualization, 3D walkthroughs, and Matterport scanning for property developers, architects, and commercial clients worldwide. The studio combines technical expertise in industry-standard tools with a focus on luxury real estate and office space visualization.

- Architectural Visualization

- Commercial Real Estate

## Core Services

- [Architectural Visualization Services](https://100cgi.com/services/architectural-visualization): High-end architectural visualization & exterior rendering for developers
- [3D Walkthrough Services](https://100cgi.com/services/3d-walkthrough-services): Cinematic 3D walkthrough animations for architecture & real estate
- [Matterport 3D Scanning Services](https://100cgi.com/services/matterport-3d-scanning): Matterport Pro3 LiDAR scanning for BIM-ready digital twins & virtual tours
